notes:
What's new in 0.23.1

• The player's controls and timeline now come up every time you press OK, not just the first.
• Back while watching goes to Choose Source, so you can try another source if one is broken.
• Settings > Playback > Play next episode: always, 3, 5 or 10 in a row, or Off (pick the next one yourself, or go to the episode list).
• Settings > Playback > Audio language: films and episodes play in your language when the file has it, instead of whatever track the file starts on.
